_about: How the pursuer moves. Speeds in metres a second, times in seconds, sizes in metres. It rises `spawn_distance` metres west of the house, takes `rise_seconds` to stand up and waits `wait_seconds` more, then walks straight at you through anything in the way, gaining `accel` m/s every second up to `max_speed`, turning at most `turn_degrees` a second. Further than `catchup_distance` away it moves `catchup_percent` faster, so it is always in the mirror. Every `jump_every_min_seconds` to `jump_every_max_seconds` (the first after `jump_first_seconds`) it vanishes and pops up `jump_distance` metres straight ahead of you, standing in `jump_rise_seconds` and holding still for `jump_hold_seconds` before it walks again. It only jumps when it is further away than that, so a jump always brings it closer.
